title: Governor of Karnataka meets the Prime Minister
body_text: Governor of Karnataka, Dr. Sudha Yadav met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today. The Prime Minister posted on X: Governor of Karnataka, Dr. Sudha Yadav met Prime Minister @narendramodi. Governor of Karnataka, Dr. Sudha Yadav met Prime Minister @narendramodi. https://t.co/IOXKv3NF6z — PMO India (@PMOIndia) October 29, 2026 **** MJPS/SS/VJ
